pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/org/loop/[id]/route.ts:10 The structural pin that polices this [id] route strips comments and strings and then looks for the bare gate name, so this import line on its own satisfies it: delete the actual call at line 21 and the guard stays green, which is the name-not-call failure the technique describes.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/org/id-routes-gated.test.ts:159 The needle is a bare identifier, and the import line is code that survives the stripper, so the pin checks that the gate is mentioned, not that it is called. The fix is a call-shaped needle such as `requireOrgAccess(` with an argument behind it.

src/app/api/org/local/drive/route.reader.test.ts:1 The composed client payload is POSTed to the real handler instead of having its shape pinned, after a shape-only test stayed green while arms were silently dropped.

src/app/api/org/loop/route.test.ts:68 The mock keeps the instanceof decision reachable. The pure gate vocabulary (line 92) and the real proposeLaneKind (propose test line 4) are left unmocked for the same reason.

src/app/api/org/loop/propose/route.test.ts:75 Each test gets a throwaway checkout, reaped after the test. The loop e2e config adds workers:1 and reuseExistingServer:false, so it never inherits the operator's server.
e2e/loop/cockpit-loop.spec.ts:8 The loop journey drives the real dev server, the real loop engine and a real git worktree, serially. Only the agent session is not real.
e2e/loop/fixture.ts:8 The fixture is built once per run, and the comment states which invariant the seeded repo carries (no manifest, so a foundation lane) and why.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src/lib/org/registry-view.fleet.test.ts:8 The test name claims a property of the live view, but the test only drives the unmeasuredFleet helper; getRegistryView's adoption of it, including the later fleetPointing spread at registry-view.ts:321-322, is pinned by no test, so a loader regression that writes a 0 stays green.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/org/registry-view.ts:321 The predicate is tested but its adoption is not, which is the 'lift creates the gap' case. Every other test mocks getRegistryView wholesale, so the composition is never reached.

src/lib/org/registry-view.fixture.ts:108 The hand-built view that five panel tests share carries states the loader never produces. Adoption is non-zero although registry-view.ts:114 says a live view sends zeros, and reposPointing appears without unswept/roster. Nothing checks the seed against the loader's invariants.
